chunks: Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman al-Khazzaz asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام:

"Which type of hajj is best?" He said: "al-Mut'ah. And how could anything be better than it, while the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله says: 'If I had known at the beginning of my affair what I came to know at its end, I would have done as the people did.'"

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: best or most excellent in rank
key_terms.اسْتَدْبَرْتُ: what came later or what was realized afterward
key_terms.اسْتَقْبَلْتُ: I had faced beforehand; meaning if I had known earlier
key_terms.الْمُتْعَةُ: Hajj al-Tamattu', the form of hajj joined with 'umrah before hajj
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, cited as proof

ai.seo_question: Which type of hajj is considered the best in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Hajj al-Tamattu' is the best type of hajj. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام supports this ruling by citing the statement of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, indicating the superiority and strong sunnah basis of Tamattu'.
